<!-- GENERATED by scripts/gen-api-reference.ts from sdk/openapi.json. Do not edit — including in Studio; the next build replaces this file. -->

::api-operation{method="POST" path="/v1/businesses/{biz}/team_alert_recipients/resend"}
#docs
Limited per address: 429 when we sent too many confirmation emails to it.

## Path parameters

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `biz` | `string` | **yes** | Business id (biz_…) |

## Headers

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `Idempotency-Key` | `string` | no | Safely retry writes — repeats return the original response. If a write FAILED after it had already taken effect, that failure is what repeats: the key is spent, and a new attempt needs a new key. |

## Body

The request body is **required**.

| Field | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `email` | `string` | **yes** | The resend's email address. |

## Response

| Field | Type | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `object` | `string` | The object type; always `team_alert_recipient`. One of `team_alert_recipient`. |
| `email` | `string` | The address. |
| `state` | `string` | `member`: a team member, gets alerts. `confirmed`: confirmed by email, gets alerts. `pending`: gets no alerts until the address is confirmed. One of `member`, `confirmed`, `pending`. |
| `last_sent_at` | `string · ISO-8601` | When we last sent the confirmation email. Absent from the resend answer. |

## Status codes

| Status | Meaning |
|---|---|
| `200` | Success |
| `400` | Not a pending recipient |
| `404` | Not a recipient |
| `409` | Idempotency-Key conflict — the key is already in flight, or was reused with a different request payload. |
| `429` | Too many confirmation emails to this address |

#request
```bash [Request]
curl -X POST "$TMBILLING_URL/v1/businesses/biz_XXXXXXXXXXXX01/team_alert_recipients/resend" \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $TMBILLING_API_KEY" \
  -H "Idempotency-Key: $(uuidgen)" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{
    "email": "maya@example.com"
  }'
```
